The question asks for an American country music singer-songwriter, born in May of 1942, who sang a duet with her ex-husband the same year he released "The Battle."  
From the source [The Battle (George Jones song)], the song "The Battle" was released in 1976, and the duet "Golden Ring" with his estranged ex-wife Tammy Wynette became a #1 hit that same year.  
From [Tammy Wynette], her birth date is May 5, 1942, which matches "born in May of 1942."  

Final answer: Tammy Wynette
